management_monitors.caveat: Monitors are configured outside the repository; there is no in-repo definition to evidence them. Keyword matching in the free tier is unavailable, so the checks are status-code only.

mail_path.blob1: drop reason, empty for forwarded and errored
mail_path.secret_provisioning: GitHub Actions cd.yml deploy-worker job writes Worker secrets CF_ACCOUNT_ID and CF_API_TOKEN before wrangler deploy; the account ID comes from GitHub secret CF_ANALYTICS_ACCOUNT_ID when set, otherwise from CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (the same Cloudflare account), and the token from CF_ANALYTICS_API_TOKEN
mail_path.production_clock_status: pending deployment of the Worker bundle that contains the counters
mail_path.formula: forwarded / (forwarded + errored); intentional policy drops and unknown-recipient drops are excluded

caveats: No monthly percentage can be quoted until the first full window closes; the matrix actual stays 'pending 30-day window'.
Analytics Engine may sample at high volume; the aggregation SQL uses SUM(_sample_interval) so counts remain weighted.
The counters are best effort: a missing binding or a failed writeDataPoint cannot change a mail decision, so a gap in the data is possible.
Mail-path availability intentionally excludes drops, because policy blocks and unroutable recipients are not unavailability.
